name: Portfolio Management & Performance Attribution
description: Portfolio positioning, risk budgets, and performance attribution for any managed book.

metrics.name: allocation_effect
metrics.description: Brinson allocation effect for the period
metrics.additivity_rationale: Single-period Brinson effects sum across segments to the active return by construction.

metrics.name: selection_effect
metrics.description: Brinson selection effect for the period
metrics.additivity_rationale: Single-period Brinson effects sum across segments to the active return by construction.

metrics.name: ex_ante_tracking_error
metrics.description: Forecast tracking error from the risk model

metrics.name: turnover
metrics.description: Traded value divided by average portfolio value

conventions.rule: Single-period attribution effects add across segments to the total active return; multi-period effects need a linking method, which must be named.
Weights sum to 100% within a portfolio; active weights sum to zero.

caveats.text: Multi-period attribution depends on the linking method; results are not unique.

chart_conventions.rule: Show attribution as grouped bars (allocation, selection) by segment, sorted by total effect.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
